data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 abstracts SRC_002 by recasting the latter's task-space partition (checklist-covered vs. boundary-violating) as a special case of an adversarial perturbation: the evaluation design is REFUTED IF SRC_002's stratification performance gap between compliance and competence does not vanish on non-adversarial, in-distribution items where the checklist's mapping is clean, contradicting SRC_005's requirement that the distinction is observable only under distribution shift.
